chapter: Hutto 1978-79: Specht, Weems and learning to play
title: Lyons Corner House in London and flying to France
summary: The Specht band played at the Lyons Corner House in London; Morehouse did not play in France, which was just vacation, because the French musicians did not want outsiders.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now the Specht Band played in London in a room called the Corner Room or something to that effect.
That was owned by a great, the biggest candy store in London. It was on the main street.
And I think you had a picture of that with an arrow pointing to that building.
And I have a reference in a book by Brian Rust in England about the band playing possibly.
Now you went to France, Did you play in France or not?
It was just part of the vacation.
Because none of the Frenchmen knew us at all. And they didn't want to take a chance on putting a rough guy in there and spoiling their caliber of music.
